house_style: Contemporary editorial illustration for a high-school personal finance tool, like a feature in a modern magazine: flat but textured shapes, retro-futurist brass and teal palette, subtle grain. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.

assets.name: machine
assets.prompt: A whimsical retro-futurist time machine: a round brass-and-teal capsule chair with big dials, glowing tubes, a large lever on the side and a swirl of glowing light around its base. Front three-quarter view.

assets.name: stocks
assets.prompt: A small cluster of company buildings standing together: a factory with a chimney, a shop with an awning, an office tower and a farm silo, all on one little round base. Represents owning a slice of many companies.

assets.name: bonds
assets.prompt: An ornate paper bond certificate with a scalloped border, a wax seal ribbon and a strip of small tear-off coupons along the bottom edge, slightly curled. The paper has only decorative swirls, no writing.

assets.name: cash
assets.prompt: A sturdy little teal steel savings safe with its round door open, a neat stack of paper bills and a few coins inside.

assets.name: gold
assets.prompt: A small neat pyramid stack of shiny gold bars.
